item.dc:creator: Sieg, Julie; Dixon, Cori; Elwell, Sue et al.
item.description: Abstract The monarch butterfly (Danaus plexippus) is one of the most iconic butterflies worldwide. Alarmingly, the North American population has declined steadily over the last three decades. The western population in particular has fallen substantially from overwintering numbers in the millions to less than 10,000.
